name: Kanto Reloaded
author: Stonewall
description: An overhaul for KIF: controls, menus, PC, battle tools and more. Every feature can be switched on or off.

permission_notes.save_files: Looks after your saves: notes, backups, the Deleted tab, safe saving and the Save Checker's fixes.
permission_notes.game_files: Keeps Randomizer presets and Publish a Mod's copies in the game folder.
permission_notes.clipboard: Copies paths, links, seeds and settings codes, and pastes into its text fields.
permission_notes.marshal: Reads your saves and backups to show and check them.
permission_notes.eval: Brings back other mods' settings in KIF Settings when they load after Kanto Reloaded.
